title: Hermitian manifolds with nonpositive holomorphic sectional curvature
summary: We study compact Kähler manifolds admitting Hermitian metrics with nonpositive holomorphic sectional curvature. We prove that the canonical bundle of such a manifold is nef, removing the pluriclosed assumption from the corresponding nefness result of Broder-Stanfield \cite{BroderStanfield}. In complex dimension two, we further show that negative holomorphic sectional curvature implies the ampleness of the canonical bundle.
